lines: You never even look at me, always moving ahead
I’m jealous of that talent of yours
Don’t mock me, it’s just a nuisance
I have remained trapped by you all this time
I have always longed for that place
I have always been laughed at as a fake
It isn’t rock; I want to live rock
I thought I’d lived a life full of talent
I pretended to be a model student, but I’m a shabby underachiever
It was just a hunch, but I felt it would work out
I wasn’t proper, but I wanted to be special
Because with words you can say anything
I have remained abandoned by you all this time
Someday I want to catch up there
I have always been laughed at as a coward
At some point everything became invisible
It isn’t rock; I want to live rock
Because I changed, because I changed
Because I’ve awakened, because I’ve awakened
Because with words you can say anything
Even if I cry, you’ll never look back
I have been trapped by you all this time
I have always longed for that place
Surely I’ll never become a flower, but
Like a weed, I fall and get stepped on yet I rise
Because you were there, I stand here
